learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the thrilling world of track and field athletics by mastering the basic skills of running, jumping, and throwing like an Olympian!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sprinting is running at your maximum speed over a short distance. To be a fast sprinter, you need the perfect starting stance, strong arm swings, and high knee action!
A relay race is the ultimate team running event! You and your friends pass a baton to each other while running at top speed, which requires amazing coordination and trust.
Long jump and high jump are all about explosive power! You learn how to run fast, launch yourself off one foot, fly through the air safely, and land like a pro.
In throwing events like shot put or javelin, you use your whole body, not just your arms. It takes great technique to transfer energy from your legs through your core to throw the object super far!

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The DIY Relay Race
fun_activity.instructions: Grab a rolled-up newspaper to use as a baton and practice passing it smoothly with a friend while jogging in your backyard or a nearby park!

quick_recap: ⭐ Athletics is the foundation of all sports, focusing on the natural human movements of running, jumping, and throwing.
⭐ Mastering proper techniques like the correct starting stance and baton passing makes you faster, stronger, and safer.
